name: Realm: glacial highlands (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic glacial highland photographed on location like a feature-film still - blue ice, snowfields, bare rock and dark pine, timber and stone mountain villages, thin cold light with long blue shadows and drifting breath-mist; any magic is a faint cold glow in the ice; nothing from the modern world
notes: The ice homeland as a place: use it with the backgrounds in backgrounds/fantasy/country/ice/ (set components.realm).
